summary.text: DermGPT is described as an AI-powered dermatology chatbot intended to improve clinic productivity and streamline dermatology workflows by providing cited answers from curated dermatology literature.

medical_purpose.text: Intended as an assistant for dermatologists and staff to support practice management tasks and access dermatology knowledge; not a stand-alone decision maker or replacement for medical care/decision-making.

acceptable_input.text: User prompts and queries; underlying curated literature base.
Input: natural language text; Output: natural language text (with citations), plus generated documents/letters.
Use via the web app by prompting the chatbot; outputs are described as including citations and requiring proofreading.

output.text: Natural-language answers and drafts for clinical/admin tasks (e.g., patient education, prior authorizations, messaging responses, study support).

role_in_decision_making.text: Not explicitly stated; likely low-to-moderate because it is a language assistant that could still produce incorrect medical content if misused.

Intended as an assistant for dermatologists and staff to support practice management tasks and access dermatology knowledge; not a stand-alone decision maker or replacement for medical care/decision-making.

intended_users.text: Dermatologists and dermatology staff (RNs, MAs, ancillary staff); some sources describe broader audiences, but primary positioning is clinical workflow support.
No special technical expertise described; clinical expertise required to appropriately apply outputs.

target_patient_population.text: Not specified; tool is primarily provider-facing.

known_failure_modes.text: Not a substitute for professional medical advice; limitations include dependence on curated literature and typical LLM risks (incorrect outputs/hallucinations), mitigated by clinician oversight.

unsupported_clinical_scenarios.text: AI can create inaccuracies; users should proofread content.
